description: This file contains the partial implementation of the CosmosReminderTable class, which manages reminder data stored in Azure Cosmos DB for the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initializing the database resources, reading, upserting, and removing reminder entries, as well as handling Cosmos DB client setup and operations.

classes.name: CosmosReminderTable
classes.description: A class that implements IReminderTable to interface with Azure Cosmos DB for storing reminders in Orleans.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes Cosmos DB client and resources, creating database and container if needed.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminders for a specific grain identified by GrainId.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminders within a specified range of hash values.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry by grainId and reminderName.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in Cosmos DB.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Deletes a specific reminder entry identified by grainId and reminderName.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all reminder entries from the Cosmos DB collection (test only).

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes the Cosmos DB client.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Attempts to delete the Cosmos DB database.

methods.name: TryCreateCosmosResources
methods.description: Ensures the database and container for reminders exist, creating them if necessary.

methods.name: FromEntity
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntity to a ReminderEntry object.

methods.name: ToEntity
methods.description: Converts a ReminderEntry to a ReminderEntity for storage.
